what: A white text box opens and appears from 0 height if vertical writing or 0 width if horizontal, over 1s (GSAP default curve), and from .6s later its characters turn on one at a time at .15s intervals. The next box in the same group opens .2s before the previous box finishes. A box opened offset sideways (x) rests 1s after fully opening and returns to place over 1s — a scene where the large Hero phrase is split across four white cells and written out one character at a time.

options.group: Same group name — items with the same name open one after another
options.axis: height · width — if empty, chosen by text direction (writing-mode)
options.x: Sideways opening distance in px, default 0 — original 36 · 0 · −36 · −72
options.hold: Rest before returning in place after fully open (s), default 1
options.start: enter means when it reaches 85% of the screen, default right on load
options.[data-fx-part=text]: (If present) Text to split — whole box if absent

use:
The company is
